newsitem.title: USA: Commonwealth to buy back 900,000 shares.
newsitem.headline: Commonwealth to buy back 900,000 shares.

text.p: Commonwealth Bancorp said Thursday its board of directors had authorized a repurchase of up to 900,000 shares or about five percent of its common stock.
Commonwealth said the buyback was in addition to the recently completed repurchase of 400,000 shares to fund its recognition and retention plan.
It said it would hold the shares that it planned to buy as treasury stock, available for general corporate purposes.
Weighted average number of shares outstanding totaled 17.1 million shares at the end of the fourth quarter ended December 31.
Commonwealth made a stock offering on June 14.
The stock's closed higher at 15-1/8 on January 22, when it was last traded.
